description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Electrical Machines topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: electrical-machines

facts.claim: MMF = flux × reluctance (Hopkinson's law, like Ohm's law)

source.quote: can be described by Hopkinson's law, which bears a superficial resemblance to Ohm's law

facts.claim: MMF drives flux as EMF drives current

source.quote: magnetomotive force (MMF) 'drives' magnetic flux through magnetic circuits

facts.claim: Induced emf equals the rate of change of flux linkage

source.quote: the electromotive force (emf) around a closed circuit is equal to the negative rate of change of the ma

facts.claim: The induced current opposes the change in flux (Lenz)

source.quote: its magnetic field opposes the change in the original magnetic flux

facts.claim: Voltage ratio equals turns ratio

source.quote: The transformer winding voltage ratio is equal to the winding turns ratio

facts.claim: Varying primary current creates a varying core flux linking the secondary

source.quote: A varying current in the transformer's primary winding creates a varying magnetic flux in the transformer core

facts.claim: The open-circuit (no-load) test gives the excitation branch (core loss)

source.quote: The open-circuit test, or no-load test, is one of the methods used in electrical engineering to determine the no-load impedance in the excitation branch

facts.claim: The short-circuit test gives the series impedance (copper loss)

source.quote: Another method of determining the series impedance of a real transformer is the short-circuit test

facts.claim: Windings are connected in delta (Δ) or star (Y)

source.quote: Transformer windings consist of either delta (often symbolised as 'Δ') or star (often symbolised as 'Y') configurations

facts.claim: Three phases are 120° apart

source.quote: each of the three phases is offset by 120 degrees of phase shift relative to the others

facts.claim: An autotransformer has a single winding with a tap

source.quote: An autotransformer has a single winding with two end terminals and one or more terminals at intermediate tap points

facts.claim: Part of the power is transferred directly (conductively), not all by induction

source.quote: part of the output current flows directly from the input to the output (through the series section), and only part is transferred inductively

facts.claim: Slip = (synchronous speed − rotor speed) / synchronous speed

source.quote: The difference, or "slip," between actual and synchronous speed

facts.claim: The rotor always runs slightly slower than synchronous speed

source.quote: an induction motor always operates slightly slower than synchronous speed

facts.claim: Rotor current (and torque) comes from induction by the stator field

source.quote: the electric current in the rotor that produces torque is obtained by electromagnetic induction

facts.claim: More slip induces more rotor current and more torque

source.quote: As the speed of the rotor drops below synchronous speed, the rotation rate of the magnetic field in the rotor increases, inducing more current in the windings and creating more torque

facts.claim: A single-phase induction motor needs an auxiliary (starting) winding

source.quote: Larger single phase motors are split-phase motors and have a second stator winding fed with out-of-phase current

facts.claim: A universal motor runs on AC or DC

source.quote: can operate on either AC or DC power

facts.claim: It is a series-wound commutator motor

source.quote: It is a commutated series-wound motor

facts.claim: The commutator and brushes connect the rotating armature coils

source.quote: The commutator allows each armature coil to be energized in turn and connects the rotating coils with the external power supply through brushes

facts.claim: Speed is controlled by armature voltage or field current

source.quote: using either a variable supply voltage or by changing the strength of current in its field windings

facts.claim: An alternator is a synchronous generator converting mechanical to AC electrical energy

source.quote: An alternator (or synchronous generator) is an electrical generator that converts mechanical energy to electrical energy

facts.claim: Usually a rotating field and stationary armature

source.quote: most alternators use a rotating magnetic field with a stationary armature

facts.claim: Excitation sets lagging, unity or leading power factor

source.quote: By varying the excitation of a synchronous motor, it can be made to operate at lagging, leading and unity power factor

facts.claim: It runs at synchronous speed (no slip)

source.quote: At synchronous speed the rotor poles lock to the rotating magnetic field
